about.title: Thirteen years, one way of working
about.statement: For more than 13 years we have remodeled bathrooms, kitchens and floors the same way. The right materials for each job. A work area kept clean. A crew that shows up when it says it will.
about.caption: Cuts are made outside, so the dust stays out of your house.

services.lead: Nine trades, one crew. Every photo here is from one of our own jobs.

beforeAfter.lead: Same rooms, same doorways. Drag the gold line.
beforeAfter.handle: Before and after comparison. Use the left and right arrow keys to move the divider.

build.title: What goes in before the tile
build.lead: One bathroom, first day to last. Most of this work ends up behind the walls, so we photograph it.

before.name: Before
before.text: The original bathroom. A tiled-in tub, a low window and a skylight worth keeping.

demolition.name: Demolition
demolition.text: Everything comes out, down to the studs and the subfloor. This is when we see what the old tile was hiding.

substrate.name: Backer board and floor prep
substrate.text: Cement backer board on the shower walls and an uncoupling membrane on the floor, so the tile sits on something that will not swell or move.

waterproofing.name: Waterproofing
waterproofing.text: Walls, niches and the shower pan get a continuous waterproof coat. No tile goes on until this layer is complete.

tile.name: Tile
tile.text: Laid out so the cuts land where you will not notice them, set with spacers and leveling clips, then grouted.

finished.name: Finished
finished.text: Glass, vanity, fixtures and paint. A walk-in shower with a pebble floor where the tub used to be.

aboutPage.lead: A Latino-owned remodeling crew based in Vallejo, California.
story: Gold R.R Remodeling has been remodeling homes for more than 13 years. Bathrooms and tile are where most of our jobs start, and from there the work runs to kitchens, floors, paint, drywall and finish carpentry.
We are a small crew, and that is on purpose. The people who give you the estimate are the people who do the work, in English or in Spanish.

Our tagline is "More than a service, an experience." In practice that means three plain things: we show up when we said we would, we use the appropriate materials for each project, and we keep the work area clean.

values.name: The right materials
values.text: Every project is completed using the appropriate materials for the job, including the layers you will never see once the tile is on.

values.name: A clean job site
values.text: Keeping the work area clean is one of our priorities. Floors are protected, cuts are made outside when we can, and we pick up every day.

values.name: Being on time
values.text: We tell you when we will be there and we are there. If something changes, you hear it from us first.

values.name: Service that is personal
values.text: You talk to the same people from the first call to the final walkthrough.

aboutPage.faith: We are grateful for every home we are trusted with. God bless.
